Frequently asked questions

q: Why should I use a reach campaign?

runs: The reach campaign objective is designed to maximize the unique reach of your posts. Choosing this campaign is the perfect way to drive overall awareness for your brand among a wide audience, while still being able to control the cost-per-impression. You'll have the option to choose between optimizing purely for unique reach, or reach with engagements. This objective also offers no targeting or creative restrictions.

q: When should I use a reach campaign?

runs: Post impressions are the only thing you pay for. But because the reach objective puts your >x< presence in the spotlight, you could acquire followers, website visits, likes, and reposts too. Because of this, we recommend the reach objective as your "always-on" >x< solution or the starter campaign for when your goals are more general. Choose this objective if you're looking to drive general brand awareness.

q: How much does a reach campaign cost?

i: When you run a reach campaign, you will only be charged for every 1,000 post impressions you acquire from that campaign. Any post engagements that occur as a result of these impressions are free.

runs: The cost you pay per 1,000 post impressions depends on the budget and bid you set for your campaign, as well as the targeting you select. You'll receive bid guidance based on your targeting in your campaign setup. More on

When setting up your reach campaign, you can select between automatic or target cost as your bid type. We suggest selecting target cost since this will give you the flexibility to successfully bid on 1,000 impressions from users who fit your targeting criteria, while staying near or below your target cost per 1,000 impressions. When you set up your campaign and input your bid, think of your target bid as how much you're willing to pay for every 1,000 impressions.

It's important to think carefully about the value every 1,000 post impressions bring to your business and brand awareness. The recommended bid is a good indicator of the amount you will need to bid for your campaign to reach its goal.
